verdict.rationale: Sentry documents Seer, an in-product AI debugging agent. Its Autofix feature finds root causes and generates suggested code fixes for errors and performance issues, which is AI-generated insight and suggestion drawn from the user's own monitoring data. Seer is a paid subscription add-on, and the documented insights center on issue root-cause and fixes rather than broader analysis of the data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Seer's insight quality, AI insights beyond issue debugging (e.g., trends or dashboards), availability outside the paid Seer subscription.
